subject.title: fix(gateway): skip secrets.resolve when target SecretRefs use exec providers

question: Should active command-target exec SecretRefs bypass the gateway `secrets.resolve` snapshot RPC and resolve through the CLI-local command-secret path before merge?
rationale: The patch is narrow and tested, but it changes when credential-provider commands execute locally rather than using the gateway snapshot path, so automation should not choose that security boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Accept local preflight for active exec refs
options.body: Land the PR as the intended behavior: active command targets using exec SecretRefs avoid the expected failing gateway RPC and use the existing CLI-local resolution path.

options.title: Preserve gateway-first snapshot behavior
options.body: Ask for a rework that keeps gateway snapshot resolution as the default for mixed target sets and suppresses only the known noisy failure path.

options.title: Defer to broader exec-context design
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want the narrower log-flood fix handled only after the broader exec SecretRef context contract is decided.

recommendation.title: Accept local preflight for active exec refs
recommendation.body: Land the PR as the intended behavior: active command targets using exec SecretRefs avoid the expected failing gateway RPC and use the existing CLI-local resolution path.
